name: Low-Light NeRF (LLNeRF)
definition: An unsupervised method to enhance scene representation and synthesize normal-light novel views directly from sRGB low-light images by decomposing radiance field learning into view-dependent and view-independent components.
summary: Low-Light NeRF is an unsupervised method that synthesizes normal-light novel views from low-light sRGB images by decomposing radiance into view-dependent lighting and view-independent color components.
